title: Landflow
summary: Landflow is a low-code workflow platform modelled on n8n, where every node is a plugin written in TypeScript, Python or Go and discovered over HTTP, gRPC or a message broker. These are its docs: building flows and agents, connecting tools, running and operating the host, and the API, configuration and plugin protocol references.
